# @fungi.computer/cli-version

## Functions

### reportedVersion()

```ts
function reportedVersion(stdout):
  | {
      label: "fungi" | "Spore";
      version: string;
    }
  | undefined;
```

Read an installed CLI's complete version line for update and rollback checks.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Description                                         |
| --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `stdout`  | `string` | Captured command output, trimmed before validation. |

#### Returns

The `fungi` or previous `Spore` label and valid semver token, or `undefined`
when the complete output does not match the bounded contract.

##### Type Literal

```ts
{
  label: "fungi" | "Spore";
  version: string;
}
```

| Name      | Type                   | Description                                                              |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `label`   | `"fungi"` \| `"Spore"` | Installed command label, including the previous label used for rollback. |
| `version` | `string`               | Complete version token accepted by semver validation.                    |

`undefined`

### expectReportedVersion()

```ts
function expectReportedVersion(stdout, expected): boolean;
```

Check that a newly installed CLI reports the current label and exact version.

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type     | Description                                            |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `stdout`   | `string` | Captured command output.                               |
| `expected` | `string` | Exact version expected by the updater or launch proof. |

#### Returns

`boolean`

Whether the output reports `fungi` with exactly the expected version.
